units.source_text: 尽管如此，她还是考取了第一名，升上了四年级，全校为之哗然。

en.t: Even so, she passed at the top of her class and moved up to the fourth grade, causing a sensation throughout the school.

units.source_text: 在升级仪式上，她还是背着弟弟走到校长面前领奖。

en.t: At the promotion ceremony, she still carried her little brother on her back as she went before the principal to receive her prize.

units.source_text: 学生家长目睹这个场面，不禁潸然泪下。

en.t: When the students' parents witnessed this scene, they could not help shedding tears.

units.source_text: 据说校长曾拜托县知事表彰她，这消息也传到了阿雪的耳朵里。

en.t: It was said that the principal had asked the prefectural governor to commend her, and this news also reached Ayuki's ears.

units.source_text: 但是，孩子毕竟是孩子，他们抓住她的弱点，把她奚落得抬不起头来。

en.t: But children are children after all; they seized on her weakness and mocked her until she could no longer hold her head up.

units.source_text: 阿雪从四年级的暑假开始就辍学了。

en.t: Ayuki left school starting with the summer vacation of her fourth-grade year.
